predictedRisks.riskDescription: The Genesys failure path issue remains unresolved with no fix yet available, creating uncertainty around end-to-end voice bot functionality. With 3.9 months remaining and production support already active, this integration gap threatens operational stability and member experience quality.

predictedRisks.reasoning: The Genesys failure path issue has been actively worked on with no resolution, and current WSR explicitly states 'no fix yet.' Production incident frequency related to voice bot failure paths

Implement temporary failure handling logic to gracefully manage no-match errors after third message and route to live agent with context preservation
Establish production incident monitoring dashboard for voice bot failure paths and implement automated alerting when no-match error rate exceeds threshold

predictedRisks.responseRationale: Historical enterprise pattern shows external dependency delays repeatedly convert into late-stage schedule and quality risk. Immediate escalation combined with interim failure handling protects production stability while permanent resolution is pursued.
